title: Effective-Dated Show Price Book
instructions: Implement `PriceBook` and `validate_show_features` in `pricing.py` using only the standard library. Store effective-dated prices as sorted lists per `(show_id, SEAT_TYPE)` and look them up with `bisect`. Use timezone-aware datetimes and integer minor units, and raise the documented exceptions.

evidence.label: Returns the latest price version in force at or before the instant
Raises MissingPriceError before the first version or for an unknown key
Sums prices across seat types, counting repeats
Reports every missing seat type in one sorted MissingPriceError
Rejects negative amounts, naive datetimes and duplicate valid_from
Accepts supported features case-insensitively and names unsupported ones, sorted
valid_from is inclusive, and the old price applies just before it
Keeps prices separate per show and per seat type
Compares aware datetimes by instant across time zones
Allows a zero price; an empty total is 0
